name: date
description: Reference month (first day of the month), not the release date

name: ny_ur
description: New York unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted. Forecast target.

name: ny_claims
description: NY initial unemployment claims for the week containing the 12th (survey reference week), not seasonally adjusted. Kept for reference; model with ny_claims_avg_sa.
transformation: week ending on the Saturday from the 12th to the 18th

name: ny_claims_avg
description: NY initial unemployment claims, average of all weeks ending in the month, not seasonally adjusted
transformation: mean of weeks ending in the month; NaN if fewer than 4 weeks

name: ny_claims_avg_sa
description: NY initial unemployment claims, monthly average, seasonally adjusted. Preferred NY claims column for models.
transformation: ny_claims_avg seasonally adjusted with STL in logs (period 12; robust); two-sided so mild look-ahead

name: ny_payrolls
description: New York total nonfarm employees, seasonally adjusted

name: ny_coincident
description: Philadelphia Fed coincident economic activity index for New York (combines payrolls, hours, unemployment and wages)

name: us_ur
description: US unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted

name: us_claims
description: US initial unemployment claims for the week containing the 12th, seasonally adjusted
transformation: week ending on the Saturday from the 12th to the 18th

name: spread_10y3m
description: 10-year minus 3-month Treasury constant maturity yield; negative = inverted yield curve
transformation: monthly mean of daily values (market holidays skipped)

name: fedfunds
description: Effective federal funds rate

name: nj_ur
description: New Jersey unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted

name: ct_ur
description: Connecticut unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted

name: pa_ur
description: Pennsylvania unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted

name: sp500
description: S&P 500 index daily close

name: empire_general
description: NY Fed Empire State Manufacturing Survey, current general business conditions: % of NY manufacturers reporting better minus % reporting worse, seasonally adjusted
typical_release_lag: released mid-month for the same month (before month end)

name: indeed_postings
description: Indeed job postings index for New York, seasonally adjusted, 7-day trailing average. CC BY 4.0, Indeed Hiring Lab.

name: date
description: First month of the NY sales-tax quarter (Mar, Jun, Sep or Dec), not the release date

name: selling_period
description: Months covered by the quarter (March - May, June - August, September - November, December - February)

name: status
description: P = preliminary (can still be revised), F = final. A quarter is P if any of its industry rows are P.

name: taxable_sales
description: NYS taxable sales and purchases, statewide total, not seasonally adjusted
transformation: sum of all industry groups for jurisdiction NY STATE; suppressed industries count as zero

name: taxable_sales_sa
description: NYS taxable sales and purchases, statewide total, seasonally adjusted
transformation: taxable_sales seasonally adjusted with STL in logs (period 4; seasonal 13; robust); two-sided so mild look-ahead

name: suppressed_industries
description: Number of industry groups withheld for confidentiality in that quarter (counted as zero in taxable_sales)
